units: <cite ref="Gittin 87a:22">Gitt. 87ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ודידעינן בהא ח׳ וכ׳</he> when we know about that signature that it is not Jacob’s.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 2:4">Ib. II, 4</cite> <he>עד … וחֲתִימָתוֹ בתלוש</he> unless it was written and signed on a movable material (v. <cite ref="H00107"><he>חָבַר</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 2:4:5">Y. Keth. II, 26ᶜ</cite> top <he>על חֲתִימַת העד וכ׳</he> to identify the signature of the second witness.

B. Bath. 89ᵇ כיון דלא חזי ח׳ Ms. M. (ed. אי לא חזי ח׳, Ms. H. עד דחזי חתמא) since he does not see the official stamp on the measure; a. fr.—Trnsf. חֲתִימַת זָקָן the mature manly expression which the beard gives, full manhood.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 39b:8">B. Mets. 39ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 88a:13">Yeb. 88ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91">Gen. R. s. 91</cite>; a. e.—[<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 3:8">Targ. Cant. III, 8</cite> <he>חֲתִימַת מִילָה</he> the seal of the covenant.]—Pl. <he>חֲתִימוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 21b:7">Keth. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ ידי העדים</he> the signatures (handwritings) of the witnesses; a. e.

senses.gloss: (v. חִיתּוּם) the concluding clause of a prayer.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 104a:1">Pes. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>צריך … ח׳ סמוך לחֲתִימָתוֹ</he> he must use expressions corresponding to the closing formula immediately before the latter.
<cite ref="Niddah 43b">Nidd. 43ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. (with ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 15:3">Lev. XV, 3</cite>) <he>חֲתִימַת פי האמה</he> the filling up of the aperture of the membrum (with mucus).
